The request is to move Thursday swim to 5:45pm — but I need to know which day they want to move it TO, since they said "a 17h45" (at 5:45pm) but didn't specify a new day. Wait, let me re-read: "deplace la natation de jeudi a 17h45" — this means "move the swim from Thursday to 17h45", i.e., move Thursday's swim to 5:45pm, presumably still on Thursday (just a time change). The current Thursday swim is at 5:15pm.

Let me draft the move to Thu 5:45pm.
